dedupe_keys.name: hydrogen pathways techno economics for 36 technologies 2021 2050

description: This workbook compiles cost and performance assumptions for thirty-six technologies across hydrogen production and its industrial and transport uses. The research collaborators assembled capital, fixed and variable costs, operating life, efficiency and capacity-factor values from institutional reports, datasets and journal articles. It includes standard values and projections for 2021–2050 and follows the input structure of OSeMOSYS. Mendeley supplies the Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a literature-derived technology collection without one uniform national system boundary, not observed operation of a particular hydrogen network. Projected costs and technology assumptions require scenario interpretation and should not be treated as realized market outcomes. A reviewer-assessed use is comparing hydrogen pathways within energy-system planning simulations. model-osemosys is the documented target modelling environment, although the producer says the figures can serve other tools. A separate first-review Colombia roadmap deposit does not explicitly include this workbook. No model was run.
